test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 12 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: **Choose the incorrectly spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is '**Subsistance**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Subsistance**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Subsistence**'. • **Subsistence **- (जीवन निर्वाह; जीवित रहने के लिए पर्याप्त संसाधन होने की स्थिति; जीवित रहने के लिए न्यूनतम आवश्यक): The state of having just enough resources to stay alive; the minimum necessary to survive. • *Example: They lived a **subsistence** lifestyle, growing their own food and relying on hunting and fishing.* • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Benchmark** - (मानक, मापदंड): A standard or point of reference against which things may be compared or assessed. • **Knight** - (सामंत): A medieval nobleman who was trained to fight on horseback and served his sovereign or lord. • **Aggravate** - (ख़राब करना): To make a bad situation worse; to intensify something unpleasant or harmful. 192:T90b, The correct answer is '**strangely**'.
